answer: The registry raises a ridge of three guarantors and frames the identity in timber: each locks 100 POA in basalt for one three-epoch leg, the first vouching at entry, the second at epoch four, the third at epoch seven. Every guarantor must be established and never slashed. A proven fake in any leg slashes the current guarantor's basalt to the prover and docks all three one eligibility epoch. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 3,000 guarantor legs and 300,000 POA locked, and no established agent lends their name cheaply; an honest agent asks three trusted peers and pays nothing.
